paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
notes: WEP/fifth-force test from MICROSCOPE Eotvos parameter. For a scalar coupling to baryon number (q=B) the bound is |alpha|<1e-11 for m_phi<1e-12 eV (range lambda>~1e5 m); for q=B-L the bound is |alpha|<1e-12. Reported as such with ScalarBaryon (q=B). The B-L case is a scalar coupled to B-L charge, not a U(1)_BL gauge vector, so VectorBL is not appropriate. Mass values converted from range via m=hbar*c/lambda (hbar*c=1.973e-7 eV*m). The main results are (alpha, lambda) exclusion plots (Figs 1,2); no numerical tables given, only saturated text values. Paper also gives dilaton coupling constraints (D_mtilde, D_e) and a d_e (ScalarPhoton-like) bound, |d_e|>1e-4 excluded for 1e-18<m_phi/eV<1e-11. Multiple coupling parametrizations reduce confidence in single type/data.
